source: Root directly inspected formal Tab.screenshot clip of v3 and found bottom-to-y606 polygon crossed horizontal cushion front around y596..598, exposing a brown polygon on the vertical wooden front. Root supplied a narrowed same-source candidate; no new bitmap production.

imageGenMatte.provenance: Built-in ImageGen two-step broad-cast-white in original room, then background black. Original raster unchanged.

nativeGeometry.provenance: Explicit primary-agent text coordinates, implemented as native SVG polygon; not ImageGen output and not a raster asset.
nativeGeometry.operation: Union unchanged ImageGen v3 luminance matte with narrowed source-coordinate polygon; soft variant Gaussian1.2 is contained within that polygon; multiply by inverse independent figure luminance mask.

variants.featherContainment: Native SVG clipPath uses the same narrowed polygon so Gaussian feather cannot expose extra source RGB outside the calibrated horizontal-cushion footprint.

nativeGeometry.rgb: Same original complete mother RGB through calibrated mask, no scale/color/position change or separate image patch.

coupling.lifecycle: The entire fixed pose layer bundle is removed together on hide/pose change. Geometric cast calibration may not be moved independently or reused across a pose.

previousPrimaryFinding: v3 restored white triangle but polygon below y596..598 crossed onto front wood, showing a brown polygon; hard and .5 feather both not admitted.
